description.tr: Şâfiî fıkıh âlimi, Zebeyde'li, doğumu ve vefatı burada.
description.en: A Shāfiʿī jurist, from Zabīd, both his birth and death occurred there.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAbd al-Karīm b. Ibrāhīm, Ibn Ziyād al-Ghaysī al-Muqassarī — attributed to al-Muqāṣara from the tribes of ʿAk b. ʿAdnān — Abū al-Ḍiyāʾ

tr: Abdurrahman b. Abdülkerim b. İbrahim, İbn Ziyâd el-Gaysî el-Mukasrî — Ak b. Adnân kabilelerinden el-Mukaasara'ya nisbeten — Ebûd-Diyâ
ar: عبد الرحمن بن عبد الكريم بن إبراهيم، ابن زياد الغيثي المقصري - نسبة إلى المقاصرة من بطون عك بن عدنان - أبو الضياء
